entities.summary: Ryo Ishibashi  is a Japanese actor and singer. He is known internationally for his starring roles in the film horror films Audition (1999), Suicide Club (2001), The Grudge (2004) and its sequel The Grudge 2 (2006). He is also the lead singer of the Japanese rock band ARB.
